WITH date_filter AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-19' AS date) AND CAST('2000-09-02' AS date)
),
ssr AS (
  SELECT s.s_store_id,
         SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
         SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS profit,
         CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2)) AS returns,
         CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2)) AS profit_loss
  FROM store_sales ss
  JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
  WHERE ss.ss_sold_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_filter)
  GROUP BY s.s_store_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT s.s_store_id,
         CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2)) AS sales,
         CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2)) AS profit,
         SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS returns,
         SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS profit_loss
  FROM store_returns sr
  JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
  WHERE sr.sr_returned_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_filter)
  GROUP BY s.s_store_id
),
csr AS (
  SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_id,
         SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
         SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS profit,
         CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2)) AS returns,
         CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2)) AS profit_loss
  FROM catalog_sales cs
  JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
  WHERE cs.cs_sold_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_filter)
  GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_id,
         CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2)) AS sales,
         CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2)) AS profit,
         SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS returns,
         SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS profit_loss
  FROM catalog_returns cr
  JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
  WHERE cr.cr_returned_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_filter)
  GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_id
),
wsr AS (
  SELECT ws.web_site_id,
         SUM(wsales.ws_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
         SUM(wsales.ws_net_profit) AS profit,
         CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2)) AS returns,
         CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2)) AS profit_loss
  FROM web_sales wsales
  JOIN web_site ws ON wsales.ws_web_site_sk = ws.web_site_sk
  WHERE wsales.ws_sold_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_filter)
  GROUP BY ws.web_site_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ws.web_site_id,
         CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2)) AS sales,
         CAST(0 AS numeric(10,2)) AS profit,
         SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS returns,
         SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS profit_loss
  FROM web_returns wr
  LEFT JOIN web_sales wsales ON wr.wr_item_sk = wsales.ws_item_sk AND wr.wr_order_number = wsales.ws_order_number
  JOIN web_site ws ON wsales.ws_web_site_sk = ws.web_site_sk
  WHERE wr.wr_returned_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_filter)
  GROUP BY ws.web_site_id
)
SELECT channel,
       id,
       SUM(sales) AS sales,
       SUM(returns) AS returns,
       SUM(profit) AS profit
FROM (
  SELECT 'store channel' AS channel,
         'store' || s_store_id AS id,
         sales,
         returns,
         (profit - profit_loss) AS profit
  FROM ssr
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'catalog channel' AS channel,
         'catalog_page' || cp_catalog_page_id AS id,
         sales,
         returns,
         (profit - profit_loss) AS profit
  FROM csr
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'web channel' AS channel,
         'web_site' || web_site_id AS id,
         sales,
         returns,
         (profit - profit_loss) AS profit
  FROM wsr
) AS x
GROUP BY ROLLUP (channel, id)
ORDER BY channel, id
LIMIT 100
